0022600140.text: The Pelicans (0-3, home 0-1, on a three-game losing streak) are 5th in the Southwest and 14th in the West, while the Nuggets (1-2, road 0-1 and coming off a one-game losing streak) sit 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West. New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee, bruise), while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee, sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle, sprain) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The Pelicans trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 141-135 loss in Denver on October 24, and they also lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season series.
